description: Easy SAT — D=14, P=7, K=5. Generous cadence (sum=20), moderate pillar bounds, permissive fit, short diversity windows. Solver finds a calendar honoring all constraints; objective lands at the pillar_max-driven ceiling of 70.
_optimum_note: Pillar_max-bound ceiling: 6*5 + 4*4 + 5*3 + 4*2 + 3*1 = 70. Confirmed end-to-end in the E2 shipping validation run on 2026-05-09.
_greedy_note: Constraint-blind greedy (highest pillar_weight first, no fit/gap/coverage) would assign pillar_1 to every slot until exhausting pillar_max=6, then pillar_2 until 4, etc — totals 6*5+4*4+5*3+4*2+3*1=70 in objective alone but VIOLATES min_gap on platforms with cadence > min_gap (e.g. X has cadence=7 and min_gap=2; pillar_1 can appear at most ceil(14/2)=7 times spaced — but it can't appear 6 times AND honor fit constraints on YouTube/Instagram). Greedy returns a non-feasible schedule.
_diversity_bounds: min_gap=3 means same pillar must be 3+ days apart on platforms 1,3,5. min_gap=2 (X) is the easiest. min_gap=7 (YouTube/Blog) effectively limits same-pillar to 2 appearances across D=14.
